text_block_list.text:
The Spring Fan Thanksgiving. Today, the 
academy was bustling with crowds of both 
Umamusume and fans alike.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Have you seen Gold Ship?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, where the hell did they go...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin, Bakushin, Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Dammit, Bakushin O is running wild too?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, what should I do to prevent 
confusion? First, Gold Ship... or should 
it be someone else?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Out of the way, out of the way! Turbo's 
coming through! The main street belongs to 
Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Every last one of them doing whatever they 
want! Try standing in my shoes having to 
clean up after you all...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I shouldn't have agreed to do patrol 
duty.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, this is entirely the Empress's 
fault. Constantly nagging me to go to 
work...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm so busy I could use any help I can 
get. Putting one person in charge of the 
plaza is just reckless.
choice_data_list: Why not ask someone for help, then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: All right! Then let's get going, you guys!

text_block_list.name: Miho Dorm Resident
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am! Big Sis, I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Leave handling Ms. Turbo to me. After all, 
the Student Council has helped me so much.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Brian-senpai, please give me some work 
too! I'll show you just how awesome I can 
be!

When I spread the word that “Narita Brian 
is in trouble,” several Umamusume 
immediately offered to help.
choice_data_list:
Everyone says they want to help you out, 
Brian.

Everyone says they want to help you out, 
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Shouldn't you be helping out the 
student council instead of me?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! What should I do?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Do as you like.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~!? Aww, and here I finally had a 
chance with Brian-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume at the Stall
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek~~~!? The Sack-Bag Yokai has 
appeared~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, Gold Ship?! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"You come too! Catching that one is gonna 
be a real pain!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Wait, Gold Ship!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Uhyooooh!? I don't have a bag for Brian~?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... I won't give them room to enjoy 
this! Vodka, at 3 o'clock!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Daaammit! You'll pay for thissss!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~! Saying things like "three o'clock"! 
That phrasing is just way too cool...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Mm. Good work, Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh, Senpai...?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, one more time! Please say it one 
more time!!

And so, one could see Narita Brian, vice 
president of the student council, being 
deeply adored.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "Senpai! What should I do next?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Settle down. Just savor the fact 
that nothing is happening.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're quite adored, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I heard you've been working alongside 
various students to get things done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel proud seeing you like this. 
Someday, I would love to see a student 
council led by you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I refuse.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, well, how cold.

Even as several more students offered 
their help after that, Narita Brian kept 
powering through the work on her own.
